description: Defines the StreamWrapper class that converts Guzzle streams into PHP stream resources and implements stream wrapper functionalities such as open, read, write, seek, and stat.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: Converts Guzzle streams into PHP stream resources, managing stream contexts and implementing PHP stream wrapper methods.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Creates and returns a PHP stream resource from a Guzzle StreamInterface instance.

methods.name: createStreamContext
methods.description: Creates a stream context resource for a given Guzzle stream.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the custom 'guzzle' stream wrapper if not already registered.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens the stream, initializing internal stream object based on context options.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the underlying stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the underlying stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the underlying stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Returns a detached clone of the stream.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns status information about the stream, such as mode and size.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Provides static stream information for a given URL.
